program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_b": (13.0, 9.0, 18.0),     # bottom mirror pair gm/Id
    "L_b":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),       # bottom pair length
    "gmid_c": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),    # cascode gm/Id (small Vdsat for compliance)
    "L_c":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),       # cascode length
    "vds1":   (0.20, 0.14, 0.30),    # target Vds of bottom devices
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iin = spec.get("iin", 20e-6)
    iout_t = spec.get("iout_target", 80e-6)
    ratio = int(round(iout_t / iin))
    vds1 = p["vds1"]

    # bottom mirror devices (same L, gm/Id; ratio via m)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["L_b"], iin, vds=vds1)
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["L_b"], iout_t, vds=vds1)
    # cascodes: source at vds1 (body effect included)
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], iin, vds=0.3, vsb=vds1)
    m4 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], iout_t, vds=0.9 - vds1, vsb=vds1)

    # Self-bias resistor: Vg_casc = Vgs1 + Iin*R ; Vds1 = Vg_casc - Vgs3
    R = (vds1 + m3.vgs - m1.vgs) / iin
    R = max(R, (m3.vdsat + 0.08) / iin)   # keep M3 saturated (its Vds = Iin*R)
    vds1_act = m1.vgs + iin * R - m3.vgs

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    # reference branch: iin -> R -> M3 drain (x); M3 gate = iin; M1 gate = x
    n.R("RB", "iin", "x", R)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "iin", "n1", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "x", "vss", "vss", m1)
    # output branch
    n.dev("M4", "iout", "iin", "n2", "vss", m4, m=ratio)
    n.dev("M2", "n2", "x", "vss", "vss", m2, m=ratio)

    rout = ((m4.gm + m4.gmbs) / m4.gds) * (1.0 / m2.gds) + 1.0 / m4.gds
    vcomp = vds1_act + m4.vdsat * 0.8
    # residual error: Vds2 ~ Vds1 by construction; error dominated by finite cascode Rout
    dv = abs((0.9 - vds1_act) - (iin * R))
    err = 100.0 * (dv / rout) / iout_t + 0.3
    power = (iin + iout_t) * 1.8
    return n, {"iout_err_pct": err, "rout": rout, "v_compliance": vcomp, "power": power}
